title: Silas and the Songbook
author: Jonah Almeida
blurb: Ivo Zhou, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
